## Connect with Fortrea at World Patient Safety Congress Americas 2026


Fortrea is thrilled to be participating at the World Patient Safety Congress Americas 2026 from October 13 till October 15. The meeting is a premier global event dedicated to advancing patient safety, pharmacovigilance, and medical device safety. Stop by the booth 620 and connect with our subject matter experts. We look forward to connecting with you!
